verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference or try-it/runnable examples for Bento. The only machine spec found at /api-reference/openapi.json is titled "OpenAPI Plant Store", which looks like a template placeholder rather than Bento's own API. Probes of the standard OpenAPI paths all returned 404. The CLI docs and llms.txt are adjacent features and earn no credit toward an interactive API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
